## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), per the [DCO](../DCO)
- [ ] UI actions have an equivalent MCP tool
- [ ] No new dependency, or it is justified below and uses an [allowed license](../CONTRIBUTING.md#dependencies)
- [ ] This does not weaken the [security model](../SECURITY.md#security-model), or it is explained below
- [ ] No secrets, client data or private screenshots in code, fixtures or docs
